description: Markdown links open in a new tab with noopener. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} was started with "markdown: [example](https://example.com)", which the predictable model answers with that markdown. "The reply" is the ".message-agent" element (the conversation has just one, so select it as plain ".message-agent", never with :last-of-type). "The link" is the reply's first "a" element. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The link's href attribute should be exactly "https://example.com" (allow 30s). 3. Its target attribute should be exactly "_blank". 4. Its rel attribute should be exactly "noopener noreferrer".
